name: Shiva 2.0 Unified Foundation Contract
principle: All Shiva foundations are one authenticated workspace. Account Center manages identity, sessions, recovery and device account switching; every server operation remains user-scoped.
account_center: profile + password + sessions + recovery + account switching + create account navigation
recovery: authenticated workspace backup/restore through the same authorized APIs; account password recovery must remain server-authorized
device_accounts: local account switcher stores only the session token and public identity metadata for up to 8 explicitly saved accounts

autonomous_agent.chat_history: agent runs are saved as authenticated chats

access.ai_context: Authenticated /api/message receives the same user's Memory, Projects, Tasks and current Project context.

ui.navigation: All user-facing foundations can open the other sections while the authenticated session remains the identity boundary.

security.ownership: Every authenticated workspace query/mutation is scoped to req.user.user_id
security.secrets: Provider API keys and password hashes remain server-side
security.account_switching: Switching changes the active bearer session; workspace data never crosses user ownership boundaries
security.agent: Agent actions use the same authenticated workspace APIs and cannot cross user ownership boundaries
